items.value: I hate lich portals
What kind of peacock is this?
I'm not a peacock! I'm Sych Sychev!
Hmm. A bird of prey on the property is not a good sign.
And the gloomy knight - even more so. What do you want, iron head?
Yes, my grandma sent me here. She said, like, go get some fresh air, I need to keep myself busy with something.
And you, of course, thought your sour expression would immediately help me take off? I can even see it through my helmet.
I can give you a quick start with my foot. Do you want one?
That's funny, hero. From now on, I'll call you Joker.
Now tell me, Joker, do you see those trees on the other side of the river? I need to pick some fruit from them. I wanted to fly, you see, but... ahem...
Just don't tell me you're afraid of heights.
No, no! I'm just, well, I'm not used to the body yet. I'm not used to it, that's all!
How long have you been in this body? And you still haven't gotten used to it?
No way! Enough already! Anyway, help me get all that fruit somehow, okay?
Oh... well, I'm a knight, after all, I have to help those who need help. Go to the veranda of the house for now, rest, and I'll help you with your problem.
Thanks, Joker. My wings are already hurting...
Just think, he went through all this and is still trying to live a normal life.
Oh... what's that scarecrow holding? A slingshot?
Hmm... come to think of it, I had one just like that when I was a kid. Maybe I could knock down the fruit with it?
Oh, great knight Alixander, have you come to save me?
Oh yeah, Princess Scary, I'm ten years old again and talking to myself...horrible.
Although, if you think about the feats this lady inspired me to... she’s simply a muse.
Always at your service, great ry-kh-kh-kh!
Oh, take it, I'm not at the age to play in a one-man show anymore.
Owl-Owl-Owl... take the lich, and he still helps people. At least he tries.
Okay, done! I found a slingshot, I think I can knock down the fruit with it, I used to do that as a kid.
Great! Then there's no point in wasting time, let's hurry up, it's time to get to work!
By the way, what does grandma use fruit for? Does she make jam or compote?
Jam for pancakes, I think
Oh, well, if that's the case, then I'm ready to throw you and your basket into the trees.
But, but, Hokhmach! Just no hands
By the way, what happened to you? Who are you anyway?

Sych Sychev, the Kingdom's golden knight, fought in the Dark Lord's battle. During the fight, I encountered a demon prankster, who, for fun, cursed me. Now everyone calls me Sych Sychev, and they've even turned me into a bird!
Hmm, yes, I remember something like that. It was you, I believe, who participated in the breach of the gates of the Overlord's castle? Sych Sychev, right?
Aha! What, it's not working?
No, you... you're Sych Sychev. Sych Sychev!
Okay, that's enough already. It's no use, I tried.
Listen, why do you think they turned you into an owl?
I have no idea. Although... my family has an owl on their coat of arms. And I had one on my shield, too. Maybe the demon was trying to make fun of me?
Ahaha, that's funny, by the way.
What?
It's all sad, I say...
And don't say any more, Joker.
So, first flying knight? Still thinking about becoming human?
Not once! I have a wife and two children waiting for me! By the way, any progress with my curse?
Yes, yes, I'm already close. What are you looking at, grandson? Now run on and get back to work!
He's still helping people in this state, and I'm completely falling apart. People like that need a raise.
Oh, wonderful! This is enough for jam, and pies, and pastries, and everything else too! Well done! I'm proud of you both!
Not bad at all, well done! I think this will be enough for me to make a dozen blanks!
Well, it's not much, not much. It'll only make one jar of jam. Well, it's better than nothing!
